title: Light and dark themes with variables
summary: Custom properties (--bg, --fg…) set once and overridden under [data-theme="dark"].
explanation: A custom property is any name starting with --. Set it on an element (here .card) and use it with var(--name) anywhere inside. Custom properties inherit like color does.

The dark card has data-theme="dark". The [data-theme="dark"] rule redefines the same variables, so every var() inside that card picks up the dark values. The component's own rules never mention colours directly.
var(--name, fallback) takes a second value used when the variable is not set; --muted has none here, so try removing it.
tryThis: Change --accent in .card to #2563eb: both cards' buttons turn blue.
Change data-theme on the second card to light in Items (or delete the attribute): it becomes a light card.
Write color: var(--missing, #dc2626) on .card-text: the fallback is used.
